selection: Complete four-epoch budget; minimum native validation loss, earliest tie; held-out test untouched until immutable selection and durable bank acknowledgment.

evaluation.native_duplicates: Preserve the released LC metric behavior: no code deduplication.

persistence: Worker saves independent immutable scratch snapshots. Node zero alone pulls, serializes durable writes under the common bank lock, verifies every hash, and returns a model/config/seal-bound acknowledgment before training proceeds beyond each save.
